name: low_risk_collision
description: Loyal customer with a minor, well-documented incident should be approved

request.description: Last Friday, January 10, while driving on the M-30 in Madrid near the Méndez Álvaro exit, a vehicle driving behind me failed to brake in time and collided with the rear of my Seat León. The impact caused damage to the rear bumper and the trunk door. There is an accident report signed by both drivers. The repair shop estimated the repair at approximately €2,500.

name: high_amount_natural_disaster
description: Customer with no history but a high, well-documented loss should be approved

request.description: On January 5, during the storm that hit the Community of Madrid, a tree fell on my Tesla Model 3 that was parked on Serrano street. The vehicle suffered severe damage to the panoramic roof, front hood and windshield. The official Tesla repair shop estimated the damage at €15,000. I attach photos of the incident and the emergency services report.

name: high_risk_theft_no_witnesses
description: Recent customer, high risk, theft with no witnesses → human review or rejection

request.description: I report that my BMW 3 Series was stolen during the night last Saturday while it was parked in a residential area without cameras. There are no witnesses. The vehicle is only 6 months old and was fully equipped. I request full compensation for the value of the vehicle: €8,500.
